findings.problem: The no-remote closable rule covers only a kit-local worktree handoff; once close has run (by hand, as the track session's printed command invites), the copied main-tree handoff at awaiting-merge/pr: none goes to loop-pr-state.sh, which prints unknown with no remote: nothing ever moves it.
findings.scenario: No-remote kit-local demo-1.1: user merges, track prints close, user runs it in the main shell; every later closing check reports unknown; story InProgress, board IN LOOP, branch never deleted, /clear keeps announcing it awaiting merge.
findings.closure: Closure: orchestrate.md Phase 0 step 0 and tracks.md step 0 say a main-tree handoff at awaiting-merge with pr: none (no .claude/worktrees/<slug> left) is closable without loop-pr-state.sh and without the default-branch sync when git merge-base --is-ancestor feat/<slug> HEAD succeeds, then /loop:ship step 5, handoff → shipped, git branch -d feat/<slug>; contract cases next to WT14/WT14.2 pin the phrase in both sections.

findings.problem: Track-side walk does not check the ancestors of its start folder for symlinks (a symlinked docs/ in the track is followed); pre-existing.
findings.scenario: Track's docs is a symlink ignored as a bare name; close reads files outside the worktree.

findings.problem: TOCTOU between symlink_in and copy (known limit under the careless-agent threat model).
findings.scenario: A concurrent process creates a symlink destination after the check.

findings.problem: SECRET_RE is case-sensitive: .ENV, X.PEM, Credentials.json pass unsafe_name; pre-existing.
findings.scenario: A track's docs/work/<slug>/Credentials.json is copied back.

findings.problem: KT27/KT28 do not assert 'nothing written' to main's other targets; KT28's name check is a prefix of every target.
findings.scenario: Symlink check moved into the copy loop writes earlier targets then refuses; both stay green.

findings.problem: WT13.2 pins wording, not the command; pr: none, no --merged, no loop-pr-state.sh unpinned.
findings.scenario: Rewriting the printed command to close <slug> --merged stays green.

findings.problem: Test plan does not list the round-1 added cases KT7.2, KT26-KT29, WT13-WT14.2, N3.
findings.scenario: Nothing records the additions against the plan.

findings.problem: N3 has no control case: a worktree without .kit-snapshot still gets the offer.
findings.scenario: A mutant silencing every .claude/worktrees/* session stays green.

findings.problem: The no-loop-pr-state exception sits under the closable bullet; the lead sentence still runs loop-pr-state.sh on every awaiting-merge handoff (same in tracks.md).
findings.scenario: Agent gets unknown first and never reads the exception.

findings.problem: The stopping track session is not told to close its terminal before its tree is removed.
findings.scenario: A live session runs hooks against a deleted cwd.
